# Bombu

> Native two-deck DJ performance for macOS 26+, on Intel and Apple Silicon.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://bombu.net/): Product features, compatibility, subscription and download.
- [Actual app screenshot](https://bombu.net/assets/bombu-workspace.png): Owner-provided capture of Bombu’s waveforms and performance pads.
- [Terms](https://bombu.net/terms.html): Licensing, billing, compatibility, testing and liability.
- [Sitemap](https://bombu.net/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages.

## What Bombu does

Bombu is a native Mac DJ app with a blue/violet two-deck workspace, detailed waveforms and beat grids. It is designed around a wired Pioneer DDJ-FLX4 workflow. Tracks and audio processing stay local; audio is not uploaded.

## Compatibility

macOS 26+, on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs. Wired controller/audio workflow; Bluetooth audio is not supported. Keep at least 5 GB of free disk space available, as described in the Terms.

## Audio input

Local MP3, AIF/AIFF, FLAC, WAV/WAVE and AAC (.aac/.m4a) audio, subject to native codec support. Local folders can include subfolders.

## Includes:

- Automatic smart sampler / slicer.
- Recorded vocal and instrumental samples based on your track.
- Automatic stem generation.
- RMX support.
- Automatic loop syncing.
- Automatic loudness correction.
- Similar-BPM songs inside your folder.

## Subscription and connectivity

EUR 25 per month; cancel anytime. A license is delivered by email. Internet is required for license approval and new helper analysis. Local audio processing does not imply an internet-free licensing workflow.

## Ownership and support

Owned by ShiftBEAT. Website: https://bombu.net/. Support: support@shift-beat.com.

## Download and portal status

Official download: https://github.com/davidparaschiv/bombu-only-web/releases/latest/download/Bombu.dmg. The release asset name is Bombu.dmg; the link follows the latest stable release.

The customer-portal URL still uses the previously configured Stripe link pending owner review.
